profile.headline: Software Developer - Python, Unix, C/C++, Java, Go
profile.summary:
Software Developer with extensive expertise in:
- Python development
- Agile development processes
- Unix (Linux, FreeBSD, etc)
- C/C++ development
- Java Development
- Distributed systems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and implement features on the Web Security Appliance as well as Hybrid WSA.

Included features requiring:
- Python expertise
- C Programming/debugging expertise
- Multi-process coordination/communication
- Integration of third-party libraries
- Performance tuning

positions.title: Senior DTS Engineer
positions.description:
Support third party developers integrating solutions with eBay's platform.

Responsibilities include:
- Development of sample code for third-party consumption
- Development and delivery of content at eBay Live developer conference.
- Troubleshooting and debugging of issues reported by developers
- Tracking bug fixes through the engineering organization based on third-party reports.
- Acting as an advocate for third-party developers in internal design discussions

positions.title: Licensee Support Engineer
positions.description:
Supporting third-party licensees developing PalmOS based devices.

Responsibilities include:
- Troubleshooting and debugging licensee issues surrounding their hardware implementations and Palm OS integration.
- Development of custom OS drivers and code to support third party hardware.
- Acting as a primary technical contact for licensees with issues relating to Palm OS features and implementation
- Wrote the first boot loader for Palm OS running on ARM hardware, the first non-DragonBall processor supported by Palm OS.

positions.title: DTS Engineer
positions.description:
Supporting third-party developers creating software applications on Palm OS devices.

Responsibilities include:
- Writing sample code for developers to provide examples of best practices on Palm OS.
- Writing technical notes to supplement Technical Documentation on a variety of topics.
- Development and delivery of content for Palm Developer Conferences
- Troubleshooting and debugging of developer issues

positions.title: DTS Engineer
positions.description:
Supporting third-party developers creating software applications on Apple NewtonOS devices.

Responsibilities include:
- Writing sample code
- Writing tech notes
- Writing and delivering content for Newton Developer Conferences
- Tracking and troubleshooting developer issues

patents.title: Method, apparatus, and system for selection of a port for data exchange
patents.description: A means to allow physical ports on a handheld device to be selected and managed independently of on device applications.
